verdict.rationale: incident.io documents Investigations, which start automatically the moment an incident is declared. An investigation gathers the alert and stack trace, similar past incidents, change events, recent code changes and telemetry. It then forms and tests hypotheses against code and telemetry, pressure-testing them with an adversarial agent to find the root cause. Every element of the story is covered by first-party docs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of investigation accuracy and effectiveness.
